summary: Gerdau S.A. filed a Form 6-K with a Notice to the Market disclosing that it and affiliates entered into a new US$1.125 billion senior unsecured global working capital credit facility, replacing an existing US$875 million undrawn facility. The new five-year facility, extendable by one year, is administered by Crédit Agricole CIB and includes nine creditor banks. This is a routine refinancing of a credit facility and does not constitute a special-situation transaction. No deal terms such as price per share, premium, or expected close apply, and the registrant acts as borrower/filer. No special-situation angle emerges; the filing is purely operational financing news.
